name: skillfinder
description: SkillFinder - plataforma web y movil para encontrar servicios mecanicos automotrices por geolocalizacion.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @skillfinder/api && npm run typecheck -w @skillfinder/client
scripts.grafana:logs: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml logs -f api prometheus grafana
scripts.seed:docker: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile tools run --rm seed
scripts.grafana:sync: node infra/grafana/build-dashboards.mjs && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./local-windows/SINCRONIZAR-DASHBOARDS.ps1 -User admin -Password admin
